Navigate the inner solar system

Every point is calculated from its published heliocentric orbital elements at the displayed time. Drag to rotate the J2000 ecliptic view, scroll to zoom, and click a bright point to inspect it.

Planets and the Sun are enlarged for readability. NEO markers are not physical-size scale; their color communicates catalog status.
